# simple_brilliant_app example apps

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_example_indexes.py — edit the example docstrings/READMEs, not this file. -->

Complete Flutter apps built on `simple_brilliant_app` (which wraps the connect / upload / run lifecycle). Each directory is a runnable app with its own README and, where needed, a device-side Lua app under `assets/`.

| App | Description |
|---|---|
| [`ancs_notifications`](./ancs_notifications/) | Shows the phone's notifications on the Halo display and mirrors them in the app, using the Halo firmware's **ANCS client** (`frame.ancs` Lua API, firmware >= 0.8.6). |
| [`audio_clip`](./audio_clip/) | Record streamed audio clips from the Brilliant Labs Frame into a list for review and playback and Sharing. |
| [`audio_clip_lc3`](./audio_clip_lc3/) | Record streamed audio clips from the Brilliant Labs Frame into a list for review and playback and Sharing. |
| [`audio_clip_pcm`](./audio_clip_pcm/) | Record streamed audio clips from the Brilliant Labs Frame into a list for review and playback and Sharing. |
| [`audio_duplex_sprites`](./audio_duplex_sprites/) | Halo-only: streams LC3 audio to the Halo speaker and LC3 microphone audio back to the phone while streaming 128x128 4bpp images to the display, and reports whether each stream keeps up. |
| [`ble_throughput`](./ble_throughput/) | Measures Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) throughput from Frame/Halo to phone. |
| [`camera`](./camera/) | Connects to Frame, initiates a photo capture and returns the image to the host app for display in a scrollable list. |
| [`classification_mobilenet`](./classification_mobilenet/) | Takes repeated snapshots on Frame camera, runs image classification through a Mobilenet tensorflow-lite model on the host device and prints the highest probability classes next to the image and to the Frame display. |
| [`image_gen_pollinations`](./image_gen_pollinations/) | Listens for an image generation prompt from the user, requests image generation from [Pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai/) using its [API](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/#readme) and displays the query and the generated image for display in Frame. (Note, image generation can take several seconds depending on load and other factors.) |
| [`imu_compass`](./imu_compass/) | Brilliant Labs Frame IMU Demo App. |
| [`layout`](./layout/) | Brilliant SDK Layout Sample |
| [`realtime_openai`](./realtime_openai/) | Realtime voice conversations with the [OpenAI Realtime API](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/realtime) — or any OpenAI-Realtime-compatible backend — through Brilliant Labs Halo glasses. Derived from the sibling `realtime_gemini` example. |
| [`sleep_wake`](./sleep_wake/) | Brilliant SDK Sleep Wake Sample |
| [`sound_effect_player`](./sound_effect_player/) | Plays the Halo firmware's built-in sfxr sound effect presets (pickup, laser, explosion, powerup, hit, jump, blip) through the Halo speaker using `frame.sound.play()`. |
| [`sprite_anim`](./sprite_anim/) | Basic image and sprite viewer for Brilliant Labs Halo and Frame. |
| [`sprite_viewer`](./sprite_viewer/) | Basic image and sprite viewer for Brilliant Labs Halo and Frame. |
| [`teleprompter`](./teleprompter/) | Simple teleprompter that loads a UTF-8 text file picked from the user's device and sends one line at a time for display on Frame. (If only ASCII/Latin text is required, consider the [non-Unicode plaintext teleprompter](https://github.com/brilliantLabsAR/brilliant_sdk).) |
| [`vision_api`](./vision_api/) | Captures a photo from the Brilliant Labs Frame camera, sends it to a user-specified API for processing and displays the text result. This allows for head-worn mobile computer vision/AI applications with no mobile coding required. |
